motion.name: hinge
motion.purpose: Two-frame clip from the left when a leaf opens. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Ink button for Send and Start TUI.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; background: #1a1a1a; color: #f4efe4; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2436a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Sheet button for Stop TUI and Open space.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; background: #fffaf2; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #efe6d4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2436a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Leaf tab
components.description: Selected tab with a punched square.
components.css: .ds-tab { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; background: #1a1a1a; color: #f4efe4; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem 0.45rem 0.45rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-punch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid currentColor; background: #1a1a1a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #f4efe4; display: inline-block; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2436a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Square ink-bordered container for a meter or an agent.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #fffaf2; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; color: #1a1a1a; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem 1rem; border-radius: 0; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-meter { border: 1px solid #0f6e68; color: #0f6e68; padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Composer field in the Alice panel.
components.css: .ds-field { border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; background: #fffaf2; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 0; caret-color: #2436a8; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2436a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Detent
components.description: One-pixel state mark beside an agent or a task.
components.css: .ds-detent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: Silkscreen, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #0f6e68; } .ds-detent::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #0f6e68; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard is a tabbed board drawn on a pixel grid. One leaf is open. Health, fleet, agents, and Alice are sections you hinge between. Color marks state. The only motion is a 90ms two-frame hinge.
keyCharacteristics: Bone ground on an 8px registration grid

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Teal, yellow, ultramarine, and vermilion mark state. They are not decoration on headings.

rules.name: The One Leaf Rule
rules.body: Only the open section is displayed.

rules.name: The Bitmap Rule
rules.body: Self-host Silkscreen. Do not load a hosted font stylesheet.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, glass, or blur. The hinge is the only depth cue.

dos: Do keep one leaf open and put Alice’s composer in the full-height panel.
Do use the recorded hex values.
Do stack sheets to one column below 640px.
donts: Don't add a radius, a drop shadow, glass, or gray secondary text.
Don't put a kicker above a heading.
Don't load Tailwind, DaisyUI, or a hosted font stylesheet.
